WITH required AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT size,sha256,count(*) n FROM "ArtworkDedupMedia" WHERE "runId"=? AND "artworkId"=? GROUP BY size,sha256 ), frequencies AS ( SELECT q.*,(SELECT count(DISTINCT p."artworkId") FROM "ArtworkDedupMedia" p WHERE p."runId"=? AND p.size=q.size AND p.sha256=q.sha256) frequency FROM required q ), prefix AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT * FROM (SELECT *,coalesce(sum(n) OVER(ORDER BY frequency,size,sha256 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0) before FROM frequencies) ranked WHERE before<=? ), candidate AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT i."artworkId",i."memberCount" FROM prefix q JOIN "ArtworkDedupMedia" p ON p."runId"=? AND p.size=q.size AND p.sha256=q.sha256 JOIN "ArtworkDedupItem" i ON i."runId"=p."runId" AND i."artworkId"=p."artworkId" WHERE i.status='COMPLETE' AND i."artworkId">? AND (i."memberCount">? OR i."memberCount"=? AND i."artworkId">?) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "ArtworkDedupGroupMember" m JOIN "ArtworkDedupGroupMember" earlier ON earlier."groupId"=m."groupId" AND earlier."artworkId"<m."artworkId" WHERE m."runId"=i."runId" AND m."artworkId"=i."artworkId") GROUP BY i."artworkId",i."memberCount" ORDER BY i."artworkId" LIMIT 1 ), eligible AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.*,(SELECT count(*)=2 FROM "ArtworkDedupItem" old JOIN "ArtworkDedupItem" current ON current."runId"=? AND current."artworkId"=old."artworkId" WHERE old."runId"=? AND old."artworkId" IN (?,c."artworkId") AND old.status='COMPLETE' AND old."contentSha256" IS NOT NULL AND old."contentSha256"=current."contentSha256" AND old."memberCount"=current."memberCount" AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "ArtworkDedupGroupMember" m JOIN "ArtworkDedupGroupMember" earlier ON earlier."groupId"=m."groupId" AND earlier."artworkId"<m."artworkId" WHERE m."runId"=? AND m."artworkId"=old."artworkId")) reused FROM candidate c) SELECT c.*,CASE WHEN c.reused THEN coalesce((SELECT (old.summary->>'pairedCount')::bigint FROM "ArtworkDedupVisualPair" old WHERE old."runId"=? AND old."relationKind"='PARTIAL' AND old."leftArtworkId"=least(?,c."artworkId") AND old."rightArtworkId"=greatest(?,c."artworkId")),0) ELSE coalesce((SELECT sum(least(q.n,p.n)) FROM required q JOIN ( SELECT size,sha256,count(*) n FROM "ArtworkDedupMedia" WHERE "runId"=? AND "artworkId"=c."artworkId" GROUP BY size,sha256 ) p ON q.size=p.size AND q.sha256=p.sha256),0)::bigint END paired FROM eligible c

WITH required AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT size,sha256,count(*) n FROM "ArtworkDedupMedia" WHERE "runId"=? AND "artworkId"=? GROUP BY size,sha256 ), pivot AS ( SELECT q.* FROM required q ORDER BY (SELECT count(DISTINCT p."artworkId") FROM "ArtworkDedupMedia" p WHERE p."runId"=? AND p.size=q.size AND p.sha256=q.sha256),q.size,q.sha256 LIMIT 1 ), candidates AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT i."artworkId",i."memberCount" FROM pivot q JOIN "ArtworkDedupMedia" p ON p."runId"=? AND p.size=q.size AND p.sha256=q.sha256 JOIN "ArtworkDedupItem" i ON i."runId"=p."runId" AND i."artworkId"=p."artworkId" WHERE i.status='COMPLETE' AND i."memberCount">? AND i."artworkId">? AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "ArtworkDedupGroupMember" m JOIN "ArtworkDedupGroupMember" earlier ON earlier."groupId"=m."groupId" AND earlier."artworkId"<m."artworkId" WHERE m."runId"=i."runId" AND m."artworkId"=i."artworkId") GROUP BY i."artworkId",i."memberCount",q.n HAVING count(*)>=q.n ORDER BY i."artworkId" LIMIT ? ), eligible AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.*,(SELECT count(*)=2 FROM "ArtworkDedupItem" old JOIN "ArtworkDedupItem" current ON current."runId"=? AND current."artworkId"=old."artworkId" WHERE old."runId"=? AND old."artworkId" IN (?,c."artworkId") AND old.status='COMPLETE' AND old."contentSha256" IS NOT NULL AND old."contentSha256"=current."contentSha256" AND old."memberCount"=current."memberCount" AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "ArtworkDedupGroupMember" m JOIN "ArtworkDedupGroupMember" earlier ON earlier."groupId"=m."groupId" AND earlier."artworkId"<m."artworkId" WHERE m."runId"=? AND m."artworkId"=old."artworkId")) reused FROM candidates c) SELECT c.*,CASE WHEN c.reused THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "ArtworkDedupRelation" old WHERE old."runId"=? AND old."containedArtworkId"=? AND old."containerArtworkId"=c."artworkId") ELSE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM required q WHERE q.n>(SELECT count(*) FROM "ArtworkDedupMedia" p WHERE p."runId"=? AND p."artworkId"=c."artworkId" AND p.size=q.size AND p.sha256=q.sha256)) END included FROM eligible c ORDER BY c."artworkId"

UPDATE "ArtworkDedupItem" i SET status='CHANGED',"errorCode"='CONTENT_CHANGED',"updatedAt"=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE i."runId"=? AND i.status='COMPLETE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "Artwork" a JOIN "ArtworkContentFingerprint" f ON f."artworkId"=a.id LEFT JOIN "ArtworkContentSource" s ON s."artworkId"=a.id WHERE a.id=i."artworkId" AND a."mediaRevision"=i."frozenMediaRevision" AND a."deletedAt" IS NULL AND a."archiveLifecycleState"='ACTIVE' AND s."writeToken" IS NULL AND COALESCE(s.revision,0)=i."snapshotRevision" AND COALESCE(s."mediaEpoch",0)=i."mediaEpoch" AND f."sourceRevision"=COALESCE(s.revision,0) AND f."mediaEpoch"=COALESCE(s."mediaEpoch",0) AND f."contentSha256"=i."contentSha256" AND f."fileCount"=i."memberCount" AND f."membersSignature"=i."membersSignature" AND f."algorithmVersion"=? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM artwork_artists m JOIN artwork_artist_evidence e ON e."membershipId"=m.id JOIN "Artist" ar ON ar.id=m."artistId" WHERE m."artworkId"=a.id AND m."artistId"=? AND ar."mergedIntoId" IS NULL AND e.present AND e."excludedAt" IS NULL) AND i."memberCount"=(SELECT count(*) FROM "ArtworkDedupMedia" dm WHERE dm."runId"=i."runId" AND dm."artworkId"=i."artworkId" AND dm.sha256 IS NOT NULL) )

WITH lists AS ( SELECT i."artworkId",i."contentSha256",i."memberCount",string_agg(m.size::text || ':' || m.sha256,',' ORDER BY m.size,m.sha256 COLLATE "C") canonical FROM "ArtworkDedupItem" i JOIN "ArtworkDedupMedia" m ON m."runId"=i."runId" AND m."artworkId"=i."artworkId" WHERE i."runId"=? AND i.status='COMPLETE' GROUP BY i."artworkId",i."contentSha256",i."memberCount" ), partitioned AS (SELECT *,min("artworkId") OVER(PARTITION BY canonical) representative,count(*) OVER(PARTITION BY canonical)::int n FROM lists), inserted AS (INSERT INTO "ArtworkDedupGroup" (id,"runId","contentSha256","memberCount","fileCount") SELECT md5(? || ':' || representative::text),?,min("contentSha256"),min(n),min("memberCount") FROM partitioned WHERE n>1 GROUP BY representative RETURNING id) INSERT INTO "ArtworkDedupGroupMember" ("runId","groupId","artworkId") SELECT ?,md5(? || ':' || representative::text),"artworkId" FROM partitioned WHERE n>1
